versions.name: Camp Cooper
versions.address: 6000 SW Bald Mountain Road, Willamina, OR 97396
versions.summary: A rustic Cascade Pacific Council camp in the Coast Range near Willamina, Oregon, surrounded by old-growth forest with a self-guided nature trail, a waterfall, and fishing on Lake Hurl, open year-round for weekend troop camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Cascade Pacific Council camp page. The scout-camp-map 'Oregon Trail Council' label is wrong: Camp Cooper is a Cascade Pacific Council property. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's camp page; classified conservatively as a weekend/troop-camping property; features unsurveyed.
